Features

  • Breadcrumb Navigation — Click path segments to navigate up.
  • Grid/List Views — Toggle between thumbnail grid and detailed list.
  • Sidebar Tree — Quick access to Recent, Starred, Trash, and folder tree.
  • File Operations — New folder, upload, sort, and search controls.
  • File Icons — SVG icons for folders and file types.
  • Sort Options — Sort by name, date, size, or type.
